package-by-feature.description: Place new production files in the capability they belong to. Apply when creating or moving production files or changing capability boundaries in a spec-anchored repository.

principles.description: Five principles and three context layers for spec-anchored work. Apply when the user invokes a spec-anchored command or the repository keeps capability specs under specs/.

testing.description: Testing floor for spec-anchored changes. Apply when implementing, hardening, or reviewing production code, tests, contracts, parsers, or validators in a spec-anchored repository.

truth-layer.description: Truth-layer files are read-only outside named spec-anchored flows. Apply when editing specs, golden reference tables, or the metrics ratchet baseline.
